summary: Copies surface fields from source object a2 into destination object this, reallocating the destination pixel buffer and clip-rect array when their capacities are smaller than the source's. After the capacity checks it copies the pixel data block, the clip-rect array data, and the scalar fields verbatim, then returns this.

operations.description: If destination pixel capacity (this+0x4) is smaller than source pixel capacity (a2+0x4), the pixel buffer must be reallocated.
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the old pixel buffer pointer held at this+0x0 before reallocation.
Allocate the new pixel buffer with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper sized to the source pixel capacity (a2+0x4) and store it at this+0x0.
Update destination pixel capacity this+0x4 to the source pixel capacity (a2+0x4).
If destination clip-rect capacity (this+0xC) is smaller than source clip-rect capacity (a2+0xC), the clip-rect array must be reallocated.
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the old clip-rect array pointer held at this+0x8 before reallocation.
Compute the allocation byte size for the clip-rect array as 4 * source clip-rect capacity (a2+0xC).
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper allocates the clip-rect array sized to 4 * source capacity.
Zero-initialize the freshly allocated clip-rect array in 4-byte units when the allocation succeeded.
Store the new clip-rect array pointer at this+0x8.
Update destination clip-rect capacity this+0xC to the source clip-rect capacity (a2+0xC).
Copy the pixel data block: qmemcpy(this+0x0, a2+0x0, source pixel capacity at a2+0x4).
Copy the clip-rect data block: qmemcpy(this+0x8, a2+0x8, 4 * source used clip-rect count at a2+0x14).
Copy scalar field this+0x10 from source a2+0x10.
Copy the used clip-rect count: this+0x14 = a2+0x14.
Copy surface width field: this+0x18 = a2+0x18.
Copy surface height field: this+0x1C = a2+0x1C.
Return the destination surface pointer this.
